grade_rationale: Vs the Jul 30 C+ (A system / D strategy): strategy improved from D to roughly C — expectancy flipped from -$133/trade (July) to +$167/trade over 42 trips (PF 1.098), carried by genuinely working machinery (trail/bracket exits +$75.5k, expectancy-gate rejects saved ~$17k on Aug 18 alone), and the bot ran 9 days unattended without a blowup. But the exact problem the C+ review flagged is unchanged: down-capture is still broken (2.31 vs 1.19 up over Aug 3-21, 3.9x SPY on the -$26.8k Aug 18), the bearish sleeve executed literally zero trades (0/83 funnel, PSQ hedge flat, core defense 0 fires, IWM proxy killed by its own OI floor), and options are a -$22k loss engine with a documented gate bypass. Meanwhile the system grade slipped from A to A-/B+: ledger disagrees with broker by $1,065 (MLEG backfill wrote symbol="None"), the postmortem labeled the day's biggest loser (IESC -$6.7k) as "the winner", a premium stop executed 17.6pp past its width on a junk open-auction quote, and both away-mode watchers (Claude babysit, RH auth) died silently. Net: B- — real, measured progress on expectancy and autonomy; no progress on the declared #1 problem; self-measurement got worse.

now_changes.title: Pre-register a frozen 2-week eval window with a mechanical GO/NO-GO contract; ship ranks 3-8 before day 1, then zero changes
now_changes.why: Expectancy swung +$1,455 -> +$189/trade on pure sample noise (win-rate CI +/-21.5pp at N=20); every mid-window PR resets the ~24-trade clock needed for a 95% one-sided verdict. Without a committed contract the next run is as uninterpretable as the last two, and the away-window capture 'pass' (3 up / 4 down days) would again be misread as signal.
now_changes.how: Commit a contract file (e.g. state/eval_contract_2026-09.md) before day 1: pass = (a) N>=24 closed trades, (b) expectancy>0 at 95% one-sided on realized_pl, (c) combined up+down capture >1.0 only if >=6 up AND >=6 down SPY days, (d) max DD > -5%; recompute at close with the same plain-python method the verify agent used on trades.jsonl + equity_history.jsonl. Git log proves zero .env/risk.py/prompt commits inside the window. GO-to-live requires two consecutive passing windows.
now_changes.measurement: At window close the four contract stats are computed exactly as pre-registered; verdict is whatever the file says, no post-hoc metrics admitted.

now_changes.title: Harden watchdog option premium-stop marks: 2-tick confirmation + two-sided-quote sanity + first-5-minutes-after-open suppression
now_changes.why: All three planners converged here. The HL stop executed at -67.6% vs its -50% width 14 seconds after the open while the underlying traded UP — the Jul 23 junk one-sided-quote mode on EXIT marks (PR #40 hardened entries only). -$3,650 = 30% of Aug 20's loss, and it contaminates the entire options sample so no verdict on the sleeve is possible until exit marks are real.

now_changes.title: Close the options bypass: run the equity anti-chase gate inside risk.evaluate_option + cap per-underlying premium at 0.5% equity
now_changes.why: Two planners converged. HL documented its own bypass: equity blocked as overextended (RSI 70, 4.2xATR), identical thesis expressed as a $5,200 spread that lost -67.6% in 21h. Options are the cycle's loss engine (-$22,149 vs equity +$29,180; bull_call_spread 0-for-4, -$33,794) and AMZN concentrated ~$29.8k premium in one underlying (-$14,956). Autotune sweeps zero options knobs, so this channel is invisible to the self-tuner.

Do not import social-media patterns wholesale (ORB breakouts, 0DTE buying or selling, grid/martingale, copy-trading, prompt-'improved' LLM stock picking): each family is survivorship/fee-funnel/blow-up-shaped; the only evidence-backed transfers (RVOL gate, open avoidance, VWAP discipline, vol-scaled sizing) are already in this roadmap.
social_media_verdict: The comparison is mostly an illusion, and the arithmetic kills it before strategy analysis: +40%/month compounds to 5,568%/year — 84x Medallion's 66% gross, the best audited track record in history — and would turn $10k into trillions in five years, so the claim family is self-falsifying. The population you see is the survivor tail of a distribution where 97% of persistent Brazilian day traders and >99% of Taiwanese day traders lose money after costs, plus prop-firm marketing where only 7% of challenge buyers ever receive any payout, plus martingale/short-gamma equity curves screenshotted before the month that returns -100%. A $5k account also has structural moves a $1M book cannot copy: 100% concentration in one levered small-cap or a single 0DTE contract — and '+40% on $5k' is $2,000, less than one day's mark-to-market noise on this book. What IS real in that world: the celebrated ORB paper's 41.6% IRR came from the opening relative-volume 'stocks in play' filter (not the breakout pattern influencers teach), first-15-minute entry avoidance, VWAP-relative entry discipline, and vol-scaled sizing — all four transfer here and are in the now-list or later-track. The honest mirror: this bot's +0.67% on the cycle with PF 1.098 and a failing down-capture is not good yet either — but it is measured against a broker ledger with pre-registered stats, which none of the comparison set is. Beating the fantasy is impossible; beating the actual base rate (most comparable operations lose money) is what the bot is currently doing, barely, and the roadmap targets the one thing (red-day geometry) standing between 'barely' and 'credibly'.
